requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to create and maintain my personal profile, so that the system can identify me and contact me when needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: The profile shall store a name, an address and a phone number (REQ-F-01) and may store at most one bank account (REQ-F-02).
All stored attributes are mandatory except the bank account (REQ-F-45).
Given a new profile request with all mandatory fields, when the system validates the data, then the profile is created and a confirmation is returned.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to add new products to the catalogue, so that customers can order them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each product shall have a name, description, price and image (REQ-F-03) stored as decimal for price (REQ-F-46).
All product attributes are mandatory (REQ-F-45).
Given a product creation request with valid data, when the system stores the product, then the product becomes available for order items.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit an order containing one or more items and a payment method, so that I can purchase products.

acceptance_criteria.text: An order shall reference exactly one known customer (REQ-F-08) and contain at least one order item (REQ-F-15).
Every order item shall refer to an existing product (REQ-F-16) and store quantity, unit price and a reference to exactly one product (REQ-F-06).

Given a valid order submission, when the system records the order date as the submission date and computes the total amount as Σ(quantity × unit price) (REQ-F-17), then the order status is set to submitted.
Given an order submission where the customer is unknown, when the system validates the request, then the order is rejected and no record is created (REQ-F-14).
Given an order submission containing a non‑existent product, when the system validates the items, then the order is rejected and no record is created (REQ-F-16).

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to receive a submitted order, so that it can be processed further.

acceptance_criteria.text: The status of an order may change from submitted to pending only (REQ-F-49).
Given an order with status submitted, when OrderStaff selects “receive”, then the order status becomes pending (REQ-F-18).
Given an order whose status is not submitted, when OrderStaff attempts to receive it, then the request is rejected and the status remains unchanged (REQ-F-19).

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to mark a pending order as filled, so that the items can be prepared for shipping.

acceptance_criteria.text: Status may change from pending to filled only (REQ-F-49).
Given a pending order, when OrderStaff selects “fill”, then the order status becomes filled (REQ-F-20).
Given an order whose status is not pending, when OrderStaff attempts to fill it, then the request is rejected and the status stays unchanged (REQ-F-21).

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to decline a pending order, so that it does not proceed to fulfillment.

acceptance_criteria.text: Status may change from pending to closed only (REQ-F-49).
Given a pending order, when OrderStaff selects “decline”, then the order status becomes closed (REQ-F-22).
Given an order not in pending status, when OrderStaff attempts to decline it, then the request is rejected and the status remains unchanged (REQ-F-23).

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to ship a filled order, so that the customer receives the goods.

acceptance_criteria.text: Status may change from filled to shipped only (REQ-F-49).
Given a filled order, when OrderStaff selects “ship”, then the order status becomes shipped (REQ-F-25).
Given an order whose status is not filled, when OrderStaff attempts to ship it, then the request is rejected and the status stays unchanged (REQ-F-26).

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to raise an invoice for a filled or shipped order that has no invoice, so that the customer can be billed.

acceptance_criteria.text: An invoice may be created only for orders with status filled or shipped (REQ-F-28) and only if the order does not already have an invoice (REQ-F-29).
Invoice status is initially issued (REQ-F-28) and may change only to paid (REQ-F-50).
Given an eligible order, when Accountant creates the invoice with date, amount, payment method, then the invoice is linked to the order and its status is issued.
Given an order that is declined, when Accountant attempts to raise an invoice, then the request is rejected (REQ-F-24).
Given an order whose status is submitted, pending or closed, when Accountant attempts to raise an invoice, then the request is rejected (REQ-F-30).

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to record a payment against an issued invoice, so that the invoice can be settled.

acceptance_criteria.text: Payments may be recorded only against invoices with status issued (REQ-F-32) and the payment status starts as pending (REQ-F-35).
Given an invoice with status issued, when Accountant records a payment with date, amount and method, then a payment entity is created with status pending.
Given an invoice with status paid, when a payment is submitted, then the request is rejected (REQ-F-33).
Given a failed payment, when a further payment is submitted, then the new payment is created with status pending while the failed one remains failed (REQ-F-34).
Given a pending payment, when Accountant confirms it, then the payment status becomes completed (REQ-F-35) and the invoice status becomes paid (REQ-F-36).
Given a pending payment, when Accountant rejects it, then the payment status becomes failed (REQ-F-38) and invoice and order statuses remain unchanged.
Payment status may change only from pending to completed or to failed (REQ-F-50).

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to close a shipped order whose invoice is paid, so that the order lifecycle is finished.

acceptance_criteria.text: An order may change from shipped to closed only when its linked invoice status is paid (REQ-F-40).
Given a shipped order with a paid invoice, when OrderStaff selects “close”, then the order status becomes closed (REQ-F-40).
Given a shipped order whose invoice is not paid, when OrderStaff attempts to close it, then the request is rejected and the status stays unchanged (REQ-F-41).
Given an order whose invoice is paid but whose status is not shipped, when OrderStaff attempts to close it, then the request is rejected (REQ-F-42).
Once an order reaches status closed it never changes again (REQ-F-44).

requirements.statement: When a user submits an order containing up to 50 order items under normal operating conditions, the system shall register the order and respond within 2 seconds for at least 95% of submissions.
Under normal operating conditions, the system shall support at least 200 concurrent users and at least 20 order submissions per second while meeting the response time of REQ-N-01.
The system shall authenticate every user before granting access to any customer, order, invoice or payment data, and shall reject 100% of unauthenticated requests.
The system shall allow only users holding the accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject the same request from any other user.
The system shall protect customer personal data and bank account numbers by encrypting them in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest.
The system shall record the user and the time of every status change of an order, an invoice and a payment, and shall retain these records for at least 12 months.
The system shall be available for at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 24 hours in advance.
When a server failure occurs, the system shall resume accepting requests within 15 minutes without losing any order, invoice or payment recorded before the failure.
